consequence.statement: With identical configuration, the series is now reported under the name envoy_cilium_npds_update_success, so dashboards, alerts or other consumers still querying envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_success no longer match it.
consequence.remediation: Update dashboards, alerts and other metric consumers to query envoy_cilium_npds_update_success instead of envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_success.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.17.0 renames the metric envoy_cilium_policymap_<node-ip>_<node-id>_update_success to envoy_cilium_npds_update_success.
